screens.title: Carregando: o esqueleto
screens.why: The first read draws each section's cards as skeletons, never an empty page.

pins.label: Agora's skeleton
pins.text: PlanSkeletonCard (tall): the card's fill, the play's round room, a name line, the hours and the controls' line, pulsing (AppSkeleton).

pins.label: Real headings
pins.text: Headings and Ver calendário are drawn at once; only the cards wait. A reload keeps the cards on screen (isInitialLoad).

pins.label: Para depois too
pins.text: Three skeleton rows; Pendentes is left out until it has something, as today.

screens.title: Em seguida: tudo com hora
screens.why: Every card of the day after Agora, events too, then the tasks of the next days, with no limit.

pins.label: Ver calendário
pins.text: Was 'Ver o dia' beside Agora; now 'Ver calendário' beside Em seguida (same pill, calendar icon). Agora keeps the day's mark.

pins.label: Concrete hours
pins.text: Every row has its start–end from the server's layout. A pause, a move, a task done early: on the next read every task moves to its new hour; events never move.

pins.label: All the day's events
pins.text: Standup, lunch, the call: every event of the day, sand fill and pin, in clock order between the tasks.

pins.label: Later days
pins.text: Then the tasks the queue puts on the next days, under the day's name (Amanhã, Sexta, 6 de nov.). Events of later days stay on the calendar.

pins.label: + Adicionar, no cap
pins.text: No 'up to four': the queue ends in + Adicionar, which writes right after the last task.

screens.title: Para depois, a lista inteira
screens.why: No more 'Abrir a lista': the whole backlog, and a + at its end like Em seguida's.

pins.label: Whole list
pins.text: Every loose task, then every delivery not begun, in order; still carried between sections.

pins.label: + Adicionar
pins.text: Same dense AppAddRow as Em seguida: writes a task at the end of Para depois (the backlog).

screens.title: Play pergunta quando
screens.why: Every play asks: now, or first in Em seguida at the next free hour; over an hour, how much too.

pins.label: Always asks
pins.text: PlayWhenSheet on every play of a waiting task: Plano, Pendentes, Para depois, the calendar; a delivery names its next task.

pins.label: Quanto (> 1 h)
pins.text: 30 min | 1 h | Tudo · 2h, Tudo chosen; a piece says what is left. Under an hour this row is not drawn.

pins.label: Começar agora
pins.text: The accent. With something running, the guard asks as today (Concluir / Pausar em Pendentes / Para depois). A piece begun leaves the rest in Pendentes.

pins.label: Em seguida · hora
pins.text: First place in the queue, after what runs; the hour is the first room that fits the piece (2 h hops lunch and the call: 15:50; 30 min: 10:38). A piece queued leaves the rest where it was.

screens.title: Soltar em Em seguida
screens.why: A task over an hour let go in Em seguida asks how much goes there, as Agora does.

pins.label: The place's hour
pins.text: Titled with the hour of the slot it was let go on (after the card above and the pause).

pins.label: 30 min · 1 h · Tudo
pins.text: 30 min the accent, as the play sheet was. The rest stays where it was (Para depois here). A drop on Agora keeps PlaySheet.task, the rest to Pendentes.
